releases.displayName: Additional Fixes Based on Player Feedback

items.text: Releasing additional fixes for most common issues, based on player feedback:
General stability improvements for all platforms.
Fixed an issue where the companion bot would not respawn after a player returned to a checkpoint.
Fixed an issue on Switch 2 mouse mode where interacting with equipment would cause a double input (for real this time).
Thanks to everyone who reported a bug! If you do see any other bugs you'd like to report, please let us know anytime in Discord, in #feedback.
All the best!
Prophecy Team

releases.displayName: Several New Fixes Based on Player Feedback

items.text: Releasing several fixes to most reported bugs, based on player feedback:
Fixed an issue where the Companion Bots would stop respawning in co-op.

releases.displayName: Performance and Stability Update + Bug Fixes

items.text: Fixed significant late game performance regression affecting host players introduced in v1.2.0.0.
Crash fixes and improved general stability.
Fixed an issue where killing a Deadeye bot would cause the encounter to end prematurely, and auto start future waves.
Fixed an issue where certain elemental particles would linger longer than intended.
Fixed an issue where the Venator weapon would not apply its weapon skins.
Fixed an issue with door forcefield alignment to prevent stealth from accidentally being triggered before entering the next room.
Fixed an issue where friends could show as online even after they had gone offline.
Fixed an issue where players could incorrectly despawn bots.
PC: Fixed DLSS Frame Generation being incorrectly disabled when transitioning to a different map.
[Switch 2] Fixed an issue where client players couldn't interact or ready-up while in mouse mode.
[Switch 2] Fixed an issue where motion controls got stuck on when transitioning to mouse mode.

After the latest round of performance optimizations in Version 1.2.0.0, we did see an increased crash rate and lower performance stability than usual on PC and console platforms. We apologize for the decrease in performance during this time, and really appreciate everyone's feedback in helping us identify the key issues quickly and also your patience as we worked to get this patch ready and out!

This patch should significantly improve overall performance and stability, and we'll be monitoring Steam, Discord, Reddit, and QQ closely for feedback as well to make sure everything is running smoothly. Thanks for being part of the Deadzone: Rogue community, and wishing everyone all the best!
Prophecy Team

releases.displayName: Released Several New Fixes Based on Player Feedback

items.text: Disabled the freezing mechanic on the Ice Guardian bot.

Dev Note: The freeze attack was causing a new crash for console players. We have removed the freeze attack for now, while we work on a fix for the issue. In the meantime, the Ice Guardian will use a chilling attack instead that is safe.

releases.displayName: Recommended Driver, Gameplay Updates, and Fixes

items.text: The latest NVIDIA driver versions on the R580 release branch (580.88 and 580.97) have a known critical performance issue which can result in the application crashing.
Our recommended NVIDIA driver version is now 576.88 which has been verified to not be affected by this issue.

If you are experiencing frequent crashes playing Deadzone: Rogue on NVIDIA hardware, we suggest checking your installed driver version to see if it is affected. The NVIDIA driver team is aware of the issue and is working to resolve it in a future driver update.

notes.title: How to check your NVIDIA driver version

items.text: Open the NVIDIA Control Panel: Right-click on your desktop and select "NVIDIA Control Panel".
Access System Information: In the NVIDIA Control Panel, click "System Information" located in the bottom-left corner.

Locate Driver Version: The driver version will be listed next to the "Driver Version" field within the system information window. Note that this usually represents the last five digits of the full version number.
If Affected: If your driver is 580.88 or 580.97, consider visiting the Nvidia website to download the recommended driver instead or another version of your choice.

items.text: Co-Op
To play Co-Op, you will need to link your Epic account (this is for peer-to-peer online services)
Find the Co-Op terminal in the starting ship.

To Join a Lobby, copy and paste the Host’s Lobby Code in the Join Lobby Code text box
